Designated '''CZ-198''', same as the [[CZ-198|moon]] it was located on, was an advanced facility of the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Uknown Regions]], serving a major role in Czerka production until it was [[Seizure of CZ-198|seized]] by both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during Czerka reorganization of [[3638 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.3}}</ref>

==Description==
The facility contained lavish recreational living quarters for employees who had access to a cafeteria. The Atrium was incorporated into the facility to allow Czerka employees to gather and develop new projects, while the [[Seario Memorial Showroom]] showcased the various products created by the staff of the site. In addition, a biodome with a range of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] and animal life allowed Czerka [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] to test creations in genuine conditions. Furthermore, an advanced specimen observation and testing laboratory allowed for the development of [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapons]] that could be tested in a safe environment.<ref name="FTVT">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20130628|text=Facilities: Take a Virtual Tour}}</ref>

The heart of the facility was a highly advanced [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] designed to supply CZ-198's power requirements. A central supply shipping yard utilized automated machinery in order to bring about a quick and efficient delivery of resources, such as the shipment of the latest products to customers. For security, the latest cutting-edge equipment was used to ensure the safety of the staff.<ref name="FTVT" />

The facility's landing pads served the entrance point to the moon for the rest of the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]], while the [[rocket tram]] rail system kept the facility well connected, providing access to the [[Czerka Corporate Labs|Corporate Labs]] and the [[CZ-198 Biodome facility|Biodome facility]].<ref name="Daily" />

==History==
When [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] acquired the moon which it designated as [[CZ-198]], a massive warehouse for excess manufacturing was built on its surface. Some time later, Special Executive [[Rasmus Blys]], thrilled with the moon's remote location, handpicked it for his own research laboratory. Over the years that followed, CZ-198 became a major profit center for Czerka, developing cutting-edge droids and weaponry. At the same time, a top-secret [[CZ-198 Biodome facility|Biodome facility]] was created to test Rasmus Blys's own bio-engineering projects, outside direct corporate control.<ref name="codex">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|CZ-198}}</ref>

===Seizure of the facility===
{{Main|Seizure of CZ-198}} 
In [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] was nationalized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Rasmus Blys]], still in control of CZ-198, decided to lock the [[CZ-198|moon]] down to retain his full power over the production in the facility. Hoping to seize the Czerka assets left on the moon, both the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sent in their forces, establishing a presence at the landing zones of the [[CZ-198 Shipping Department|Shipping Department]]. Using them as a staging ground, both factions sent strikes teams to other sections of the facility via a [[rocket tram]] system that was implemented by Czerka.<ref name="Daily" />

[[Seizure of CZ-198|Battle]] for the facility resulted in dozens of destroyed droids and equipment, ultimately leading to [[Rasmus Blys]] death at the hands of a strike team sent to [[Czerka Corporate Labs|Corporate Labs]]. Before his death, he activated a security system "[[Vigilant]]"<ref name="labs" /> controlled by a mutant [[Flesh Raider|Flash Raider]] based in the [[CZ-198 Biodome facility]]. Along with many creatures inhabiting Biodomes, the Vigilant was destroyed in the following stage of the operation.<ref name="core meltdown" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Czerka facility appeared in the [[August]] [[2013]] Game Update 2.3 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', the first expansion to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="Daily" />
